# Screw design norm

Hole-to-edge distance at least 1.5 × D for all drilled holes.
Minimum wall thickness 2 mm.
Internal corners need a radius of at least
3 mm for milling.
Overhangs must not exceed 45° (FDM).
Holes should be at least 2.5 mm in diameter.
Parts must fit within 250 mm of build volume.
Socket head screws per ISO 4762.
